messages:
ashley: FYI — support ticket #4521 from BetaCorp. they want streaming fncall events + token frames delivered to their webhook so downstream starts processing earlier. deadline: EOM next month.
chris: clarifying q: do they need fncall metadata interleaved with token frames, or separate event stream?
ashley: interleaved. they want events like start/chunk/end for fncalls and token frames for regular output.
maria: current arch: we stream tokens as frames; fncall payload returned at end. to meet this we need an event envelope & framing contract. @kevin can runtime emit boundary events?
kevin: yes. plan: ndjson stream with event types: fncall_start, fncall_chunk, fncall_end, token. include `call_id` and `seq`. perf note: estimated 5-12% CPU delta at high throughput. recommend opt-in flag `stream_events=true` + per-customer feature flag.
olivia: BetaCorp willing to sign for a Dedicated pilot if we can deliver opt-in. commercial is eager — might be >$10k/mo pilot.
chris: SDK impact: need new streaming parsers and helpers to re-assemble fncall chunks into tool outputs. devex should provide canonical adapter for Node/Python. also docs and migration guide.
ashley: customer asked for structured tool outputs in the chunks (JSON). they want minimal reassembly code. example chunk: {"event":"fncall_chunk","call_id":"c-001","seq":2,"payload":"{\"order_id\":123}"}
maria: we should require `payload_type` (e.g., json/text/base64) to avoid ambiguity. backward compatibility: default unchanged unless `stream_events` set.
kevin: security/telemetry: add `suppress_telemetry` option for PII-sensitive customers; if true we only emit hashes in telemetry, not raw chunk payloads. also need e2e fallback if a model variant lacks streaming hooks (server should emit final fncall as usual).
olivia: timeline tradeoff: MLP to BetaCorp in 3 weeks (RFC+API contract+pilot integration) vs production rollout in 8 weeks. they'll accept pilot-only release.
maria: proposed launch acceptance checklist:
- published API contract with examples (ndjson, event names)
- SDK streaming helpers for node/python (tests)
- perf baseline within +10% latency of current streaming
- pilot integration with BetaCorp + signed SOW/NDA
- docs + migration notes + changelog entry
chris: blockers: devex bandwidth for SDKs, runtime perf testing infra, and QA for framing edge cases (partial utf8, chunk boundaries).
kevin: i'll prototype encoder/decoder and perf run (4d). add integration test that streams mixed token+fncall events.
ashley: i'll confirm BetaCorp timeline and NDA today.
olivia: i'll work commercial terms and capture pilot pricing.
maria: OK i'll put this on the triage board as `customer-driven` and tentatively mark priority = MED. schedule refinement tomorrow 10:00am PT. react :eyes: if you can attend.
deploy-bot: issue #802 created on product board: "webhook-streaming fncall events (BetaCorp pilot)" (assignee: maria).
